recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group wants to modernize or replace the tutorial-only clinical-trial complex-extension example, handle that under a separate FHIR-I/extensibility tracker rather than as a missing application of FHIR-14296.
issue_request: FHIR-14296 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for FHIR-core extensibility.html. It said that, after removal of the ClinicalTrial extension in GF#12441, the extensibility page needed new examples; the resolution records that new examples were added and needed revision/approval.
initial_application: Two Jira-tagged commits applied the request: 557f1c4adfac22f4cec1fa80fef2db53f10ec345 changed source/extensibility.html from patient-clinicalTrial to patient-citizenship, and eae5c029592e935cbfff8c077e99c9481ee7f6f4 added the passport-number extended-extension example.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps the Extension type page to extensibility, and source/hierarchy.xml keeps extensibility.html and extensibility-examples.html in the active page hierarchy. The remaining patient-clinicalTrial text is an example.org tutorial on extensibility-examples.html, not the removed HL7 Patient clinicalTrial extension; a combined-branch FHIR-12441 audit already documents that distinction.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current build-scope source already preserves the replacement examples requested by FHIR-14296, so adding or changing examples would be redundant and risk reopening separately reviewed tutorial material.
